gpu_hours_definition: Sum of recorded training-loop seconds divided by 3600; every run used one GPU through PyTorch's cuda device interface (also used by ROCm).
hardware_assignment_note: GPU model names for Actor and BlogCatalog are read from config.accelerator.gpu_name. Runs without a recorded name are omitted from this inventory. Per-run accelerator memory was not recorded, so memory_gb is blank.
